MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outlet extender feels useful because my growing collection of connected devices creates a practical need for more organized power and charging.",
    "The Blink bundle feels like a natural expansion of my earlier door alarm purchase, and its stated Alexa compatibility connects it to the Echo devices I already use.",
    "The Mac-compatible keyboard and Echo Studio fit equipment I use, although that relevance does not mean I need to buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Fire TV Stick and third-generation Echo Dot duplicate needs covered by my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max and fourth-generation Dot purchases.",
    "My external storage purchases do not imply that I have an internal drive upgrade planned or a spare NVMe drive needing an enclosure.",
    "The iPad case requires a specific device I have not shown that I own, while another TV mount assumes a new mounting project I do not currently have.",
    "The Logitech keyboard and Echo Studio appeal to me, but my recent keyboard and Echo purchases make both easy to defer."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more speakers and streaming devices, even when they repeat functions I recently added.",
    "My history of buying computer and storage accessories seems to have been stretched into assuming I need related accessories without a matching device or project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Recent purchases often mean I have just filled a need; an older or similar replacement is less useful immediately afterward.",
    "Accessories matter when they work with equipment I actually own or solve a current problem, rather than simply belonging near something I bought before.",
    "Expanding what my setup can do, such as adding Alexa-compatible security, interests me more right now than adding another device with an existing function."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connected-home and computer interests, but miss the difference between a useful expansion and a need I have already filled."
}
